notes.title: Jurors Update
notes.content:
Special thanks to MarleyGrey on Twitch & YouTube for inadvertently helping on this update!

She pointed out several errors I'd missed in the game's text, that have been corrected in this update. 

I also used the update as an opportunity to tweak some more of the writing in a few places for better readability & flow, and adjusted a few different audio levels to normalize things a bit more.

notes.title: The NECESSARY Update
notes.content:
Removed the BEEP\BLOOP noise when progressing dialogue. 

Adjusted volume of various songs and sound effects, as well as lowering the default volume the game launches at. 

Corrected the spelling error of "Necesarry" 

Introduced a series of small grammatical tweaks. 

Added Screen movement effects to a few instances throughout the game. 

Corrected issue that was interferring with the Screen Reader and Auto-Forward mechanic

Increased default text speed when starting the game. 

Fixed link to our artist JUNI CHAVES' instagram, which previously worked but broke for some reason. 

Rewrote\Shortened the TUTORIAL

Added a few new lines for better flow in the "Get Your Chicken" branch.

notes.title: Artist Update
notes.content:
Added primary Lead Artist Juni Chaves' Instagram as a link on the main menu of the game so people can check out more of his work!

Spotted a floating pixel in Roger's eye in one of his close-ups, corrected that. 

Resized one of the ending images that experienced an error cutting off the bottom third of the frame so it's fully restored.

notes.title: Grocery Update
notes.content:
There was confusion regarding a plot point with the groceries, so I added additional context to make the intention more clear. 

Added some new sound effects. 

Rewrote & restructured some existing segments for improved flow & readability. 

I'm honestly so tired I can't remember what else, enjoy!

notes.title: Exasterbate Update
notes.content:
Commenter pointed out I misspelled Exacerbate as Exasterbate, so I fixed that. 

The "Beep" sound that plays when advancing dialogue is now on a separate audio channel with its own volume control in Preferences so it can be turned up, down, or muted; without affecting user's experience while listening to the sound effects which have their own channel. 

Updated the credits regarding post-launch contributions. 

Added a Tutorial to the game which can be optionally accessed on the main menu. 

Added a button called "Soundtrack" on the main menu which will take users to the game's OST directly since we've had many requests for links to its location. 

The Twitter\X option takes you to the Trash Eyes Dev page, the Instagram button takes you to the composer's account if you'd like to hear more of his music. 

The Main Menu background image was replaced with one that is more fitting. 

A couple other words and lines were tweaked due to user feedback, but in a way that impacts readability, no content has been meaningfully changed in that regard.

notes.title: Orifice Update
notes.content:
Due to community feedback the scene with the ATM has been altered, the story is different only in the scene with the ATM. 

New art, a new song, and new dialogue have been added to make the adjustments to the scene. 

These changes will not impact achievements. 

The end credits have been updated to include an additional contributor on the soundtrack

The role of Audio Engineer was also assigned to the credits based on community feedback.
